name: Polite Chipmunk 64
author: Afacanc38
description: Gray button that glows on hover with a smooth transition.
howItWorks:
On hover, background changes from #424242 to #353535, box-shadow becomes 0 1px 0 0 #ffffff inset,
    0 0 0 1px #000000,
    0 -1px 0 0 #000000 inset,
    0 1px 2px 1px #000000, border becomes none. On focus, background changes from #424242 to #353535, box-shadow becomes 0 1px 0 0 #ffffff inset,
    0 0 0 1px #000000,
    0 -1px 0 0 #000000 inset,
    0 1px 2px 1px #000000, border becomes none.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Polite Chipmunk 64</title>
<style>
/* Polite Chipmunk 64 by Afacanc38 — https://uiverse.io/Afacanc38/polite-chipmunk-64 */
.button {
  padding: 12px 24px;
  border: none;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: #424242;
  color: white;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .1) inset,
    0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, .7),
    0 -1px 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, .7) inset,
    0 1px 2px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, .6);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: 50ms ease-out;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.button:hover, .button:focus, .button:focus-visible {
  background: #353535;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .05) inset,
    0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, .7),
    0 -1px 0 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, .7) inset,
    0 1px 2px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, .6);
  border: none;
  outline: none;
}

.button:active {
  background: #181818;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, .7) inset,
    0 1px 0 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, .05),
    0 1px 2px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, .6) inset;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">
  Button
</button>

</body>
</html>
